segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ נִיפּוּל הַנִּמְצָא בְּתוֹךְ חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה – הֲרֵי הוּא שֶׁל בַּעַל הַשּׁוֹבָךְ. חוּץ מֵחֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה – הֲרֵי הוּא שֶׁל מוֹצְאוֹ. נִמְצָא בֵּין שְׁנֵי שׁוֹבָכוֹת; קָרוֹב לָזֶה – שֶׁלּוֹ. קָרוֹב לָזֶה – שֶׁלּוֹ. מֶחֱצָה עַל מֶחֱצָה – שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְלוֹקוּ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to a dove «chick [nippul] that was found within fifty cubits» of a dovecote, «it belongs to the owner of the dovecote.» If it was found «beyond fifty cubits» from a dovecote, «it belongs to its finder.» In a case where it «was found between two dovecotes,» if it was «close to this one,» it belongs «to» the owner of this dovecote; if it was «close to that one,» it belongs «to» the owner of that dovecote. If it was «half and half,» i.e., equidistant from the two dovecotes, «the two» owners «divide» the value of the chick.

moves.summary: within fifty cubits: dovecote owner's; beyond: finder's
between two dovecotes: nearer owner; equidistant: divide

positions.claim: a chick within fifty cubits belongs to the dovecote owner, beyond to the finder; between two dovecotes it goes by proximity, equidistant they divide
